title: Add public GitHub hygiene

context.summary: Add the public repository files and policy docs needed before Mindory can be published as a self-hostable project.
context.background: TASK-69 added release bundle bootstrap hardening. Public users still need license, contribution, security, issue/PR and support/status documentation before GitHub readiness work can move to CI and release publishing.

in: Add CONTRIBUTING.md with Mindory task process expectations.
Add a root SECURITY.md policy that points to runtime security docs and private vulnerability reporting.
Add issue templates and pull request template under .github.
Add changelog and release notes policy.
Add public support matrix and repository status documentation.
Update README and production hardening docs to reference the public baseline.
Add validation so pnpm check covers public GitHub hygiene files.
out: Long-term support version policy after first public release.
CI workflow expansion beyond existing pnpm check gate.

acceptance_criteria: LICENSE exists and states the repository license.
CONTRIBUTING.md describes the task-scoped development process and checks.
Root SECURITY.md describes vulnerability reporting and supported versions.
GitHub issue and pull request templates exist.
CHANGELOG.md documents the release notes policy.
Docs include a public support matrix and repository status.
README links the public repository files.
pnpm check validates the public GitHub hygiene baseline.

manual_checks: Confirm no release publishing or signed release automation was added.

risks: Public docs must not overstate experimental or future functionality.
Security reporting instructions must not invite public disclosure of vulnerabilities or secrets.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
